question: Do the 400 retained Research 0162 rounds contain any byte-level variation in their 18 declared learn/run artifacts, or are later rounds evidence stutter under this projection?
objects: Git tree entries for six learn transitions, six learn frontiers, and six run transitions per round
quantifiers: all four retained 100-round directories; all rounds 001..100; all 18 projected artifacts per round
arithmetic_domain: finite natural counts and exact byte-identity represented by pinned Git blob object IDs; no Real arithmetic and no additive-zero or multiplicative-identity judgment
acceptance: EvidenceStutter iff coverage is exact and every normalized round projection has the same fingerprint; VariationObserved iff coverage is exact and at least two fingerprints occur; missing coverage is Unknown, never stutter
controls: one fresh synthetic OID change must yield VariationObserved
one removed expected artifact must yield UnknownCoverageGap
one duplicate normalized coordinate must be rejected
forbidden_inferences: byte identity implies native semantic identity
stutter authorizes free or history deletion
this projection covers omitted reports, timing, or external human inputs
